map.佩戴动态血压监测要注意什么？: What to note when wearing ABPM?
map.监测日保持日常活动，避免剧烈运动与长时间卧床；袖带绑在非优势臂上臂，充气时手臂放: Keep daily activities on monitoring day, avoid strenuous exercise and prolonged bed rest; cuff on non-dominant upper arm, arm relaxed and lowered during inflation; record sleep/wake times to distinguish day/night. Results are for trend reference only.
map.夜间血压下降率多少算正常？: What nighttime drop rate is normal?
map.通常定义下降 10%–20% 为杓型（正常节律）；<10% 为非杓型，>20%: Generally a 10%-20% drop is dipper (normal); <10% non-dipper, >20% extreme or reverse dipper, the latter more common in diabetes, sleep apnea and some elderly, linked to higher cardiovascular risk.
map.晨峰血压高有什么意义？: What does high morning surge mean?
map.晨起交感神经激活使血压快速上升，晨峰过大（一般取起床后 2h 均值减夜间最低值: Morning sympathetic activation raises BP rapidly; excessive surge (usually 2h post-awakening mean minus nighttime lowest >=35 mmHg) relates to morning MI and stroke risk. Control needs regular medication and timing, decided individually by physicians.
